'''Atsuko Tanaka''' (Japanese: '''田中敦子''' ''Tanaka Atsuko'') was a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. She was born on November 14, 1962 in {{wp|Maebashi}}, {{wp|Japan}}. She passed away on August 20, 2024.
